topic: Authorizing a Friend to Pick Up a Kid

script.title: AUTHORIZING A FRIEND FOR PICKUP
script.scene_zh: 學校辦公室 · 致電授權代接
script.story_hook: Nora calls the school to name a pickup helper.
script.intro_zh: Nora 打電話給學校辦公室，指定今天由朋友代接孩子。
script.welcome_en: Hi friends, welcome back! Today we're calling the school office.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，朋友們，歡迎回來！今天我們要打電話給學校辦公室。
script.outro: That's the whole phone call! Keep listening and try it out loud.
script.outro_zh: 整通電話就到這裡！繼續聽，試著大聲唸出來。
script.practice_intro_en: Now listen once more and repeat each line.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在再聽一次，跟我一句一句跟讀。

script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】👨‍👩‍👧接孩子英文｜報姓名・核對電話・加代接人｜聽完就會用｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
臨時加班，孩子誰去接？
用英文打電話給學校，你敢開口嗎？
對方要核對資料，該怎麼辦？

這一集帶大家走進小學的辦公室，跟著媽媽 Nora 從報上姓名、核對電話，到把鄰居朋友加進今天的代接名單，全程都是自然的日常美式英語。

你會聽到：
📞 說明來意：例如「I need to change pickup today.」、「Work runs late, so my friend will go.」。
🪪 核對身分與資料：例如「Can I verify your phone number first?」、「What's her full legal name?」。
🚗 交代接孩子規定：例如「She'll show photo ID at the desk.」、「Can you text her the pickup rules?」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整通電話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次需要請人幫著接孩子，一通電話就能安心搞定！
script.thumbnail_action: holding a phone to her ear with car keys in the other hand

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good afternoon, I need to change pickup today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˌæftərˈnun aɪ nid tə tʃeɪndʒ ˈpɪkˌʌp təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 午安，我今天需要換人接孩子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure thing. Who am I speaking with?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr θɪŋ hu æm aɪ ˈspikɪŋ wɪθ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nora Chang, Ethan's mom in Room Twelve.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɔrə tʃɑŋ ˈiθənz mɑm in rum twɛlv/
dialogue.zh: 我是 Nora Chang，Room Twelve 的 Ethan 的媽媽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hi Nora. What's the change for today?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ˈnɔrə wʌts ðə tʃeɪndʒ fɔr təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 嗨 Nora。今天是要改什麼呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Work runs late, so my friend will go.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɜrk rʌnz leɪt soʊ maɪ frɛnd wɪl ɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 工作拖到晚點，所以請我朋友去接。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. Is she already on your list?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt ɪz ʃi ɔlˈrɛdi ɑn jɔr lɪst/
dialogue.zh: 了解。她已經在你的名單上了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, and that's what I'd like to fix.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ənd ðæts waɪd laɪk tə fɪks/
dialogue.zh: 沒有，這正是我想處理好的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay. Can I verify your phone number first?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ kæn aɪ ˈvɛrəˌfaɪ jɔr foʊn ˈnʌmbər fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 好的。我可以先核對你的電話號碼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, it's five five five, oh one two.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪts faɪv faɪv faɪv oʊ wʌn tu/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks. What's her full legal name?
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。她證件上的全名是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdeɪnə ˈʍɪtfiˌɛld ˈdʌbəlju eɪtʃ aɪ ˈti ˈɛf aɪ i ˈɛl di/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And how does she know Ethan?
dialogue.zh: 那她跟 Ethan 是怎麼認識的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She's our neighbor; he rides home with her.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃiz ˈaʊər ˈneɪbər hi raɪdz hoʊm wɪð hɜr/
dialogue.zh: 她是我們的鄰居，他常坐她的車回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect. She'll show photo ID at the desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt ʃil ʃoʊ ˈfoʊˌtoʊ aɪˈdi æt ðə dɛsk/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。她要在櫃台出示有照片的證件。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No problem. Can you text her the pickup rules?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈprɑbləm kæn ju tɛkst hɜr ðə ˈpɪkˌʌp rulz/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。你可以傳簡訊跟她說明接送規定嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll send it now, and add her for today.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl sɛnd ɪt naʊ ənd æd hɜr fɔr təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我現在就發，並且把她加進今天的名單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're a lifesaver. Thank you for checking.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr ə ˈlaɪfˌseɪvər θæŋk ju fɔr ˈtʃɛkɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 你真是幫了大忙，謝謝你仔細核對。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime, Nora. See you tomorrow morning.
